admission.justification: Registering a fixture, a support module or a contract for the proof would let the proof pass on inputs it owns itself instead of on module-local test source; the check is computed, so it holds without a pinned value that every catalog change would have to update.

applicability: The catalog mcp/tests/evidence-lifecycle.toml of this repository and the module mcp/tests/test_lifecycle_owned_completion_relay.py.
conditions: The proof module may be one of several consumers of an artifact; only being the sole consumer counts as owning.
exclusions: Other test modules, which may own governed support and contracts.
The descriptive fields of catalog rows, which this guard does not judge.
statement: The retained production-chain proof mcp/tests/test_lifecycle_owned_completion_relay.py owns nothing in the evidence-lifecycle catalog.
